lines.text_source: “In light and dark our path doth go. Your fate is met with stars aglow.”
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: À luz e à sombra, nosso caminho segue. Seu destino se encontra com as estrelas resplandecentes.
lines.risk_notes: poetic register in pt-BR risks sounding archaic or unnatural; source uses 'doth' (archaic EN). Translated with contemporary solemn tone to preserve gravity without archaism. Back-translation recommended to ensure emotional weight carries.
